name: Cape of the Mountebank

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

powers.name: Dimension Door
powers.text: Once per dawn, cast Dimension Door, vanishing in a puff of smoke.

summary: Once a day, cast Dimension Door in a puff of smoke.
text: Faintly reeking of brimstone, this cape lets its wearer cast Dimension Door once, with the power returning at the next dawn. You vanish in a puff of smoke and reappear inside another. Both clouds make their spaces Lightly Obscured and clear once your next turn ends.
